title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Start with a win
hook: What is the first thing your players get right at practice?
intro: Practice starts with the hardest drill.
Kids fail at it for ten minutes.
statement: An early success makes the hard parts easier to try.
q1: Do you start with something kids can do well —
q2: or start with the new skill while they are fresh?
q3: How do kids look after an early win?
t1: Every team is different. But kids take risks
t2: when they start practice feeling capable.
cta: Coaches — how do you start practice?
ctaLines: Easy win first. New skill first. A game first.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What is the first thing your players get right at practice?
Practice starts with the hardest drill. Kids fail at it for ten minutes.
An early success makes the hard parts easier to try.
Start with an easy win or start with the hard part. Both can work.
How do you start practice? Share your habit in the comments.
